column1: # Canonical MySQL/TiDB catalog and terror identity authority, transferred without changing coverage boundaries.

column5: All 954 named constants, including boundary aliases and warning identifiers, are translated verbatim and exposed from the single error authority.
All 952 code-to-message entries preserve source order, raw Go fmt templates, and every redaction argument position.
All 244 explicit code-to-SQLSTATE entries and the HY000 default are translated verbatim.

SQLError fields/display, both portable errors, catalog/default state selection, catalog and custom constructors, complete catalog fmt verbs, and redaction modes are translated. NewErrf remains partial because its public arbitrary Go fmt format/any argument surface is intentionally represented by explicit owned display/debug/type forms rather than claiming every Go fmt extension.
All 1,167 source definitions are translated; the blank placeholder is excluded while all 1,166 named constants and boundary aliases remain represented.
All 1,164 TiDB message entries preserve source order, raw templates, redaction positions, and parser/MySQL-overriding message text.

The complete fixed 27-class catalog, four source codes, class/code RFC identity, registered standard messages with redaction metadata, synthesized errors, generated message identity, root-cause class/equality behavior, registered-instance plus fixed global prototype SQLError conversion, ErrCritical, and ErrResultUndetermined are translated in the dependency leaf; mutable runtime class registration/freeze maps, logging/fatal helpers, JSON wire serialization, and Go stack capture remain outside this bounded authority
